class TestSchedulerIntradayClaimDedup:
    """[CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] get_pending_tasks dedups ONLY the exact
    legacy default pair {13:15, 14:30} created by the frontend/backend
    default mismatch — the pair cannot be retroactively classified as
    auto-created vs user-chosen, so no row is rewritten; the scheduler just
    claims at most one of the two per (user, symbol) per day. Every other
    combination keeps exact-time semantics."""

    def test_pair_claims_only_earliest_intraday(self, migration_db):
        # The frontend/backend mismatch pair: both rows active, none ran.
        _add_task(migration_db, "u1", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u1", "600519.SH", "13:15")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert [t.trigger_time for t in tasks] == ["13:15"]
        # Nothing was rewritten: both rows stay exactly as created.
        assert _states(migration_db, "u1", "600519.SH") == {
            "13:15": True,
            "14:30": True,
        }

    def test_non_default_intraday_combinations_keep_exact_semantics(
        self, migration_db
    ):
        # [P1 round4] Deliberate multi-checkpoint setups that are not the
        # default {13:15, 14:30} collision must keep running every task.
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2a", "600519.SH", "11:35")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2a", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2b", "000001.SZ", "11:35")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2b", "000001.SZ", "13:15")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert sorted((t.user_id, t.trigger_time) for t in tasks) == [
            ("u2a", "11:35"),
            ("u2a", "14:30"),
            ("u2b", "11:35"),
            ("u2b", "13:15"),
        ]

    def test_extra_checkpoint_alongside_default_pair(self, migration_db):
        # A deliberate 11:35 checkpoint coexisting with the default pair
        # still runs; only the pair itself is deduplicated.
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2c", "600519.SH", "11:35")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2c", "600519.SH", "13:15")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2c", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert [t.trigger_time for t in tasks] == ["11:35", "13:15"]

    def test_pair_before_later_trigger_time(self, migration_db):
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u2", "600519.SH", "13:15")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "13:20")
        assert [t.trigger_time for t in tasks] == ["13:15"]

    def test_earlier_intraday_ran_today_claims_nothing_else(self, migration_db):
        # 13:15 already ran today; the 14:30 sibling must not trigger a
        # second paid analysis for the same symbol on the same day.
        _add_task(
            migration_db,
            "u3",
            "600519.SH",
            "13:15",
            last_run_date="2026-08-19",
            last_run_status="success",
        )
        _add_task(migration_db, "u3", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert [t.user_id for t in tasks if t.user_id == "u3"] == []

    def test_later_intraday_ran_today_claims_nothing_else(self, migration_db):
        # 14:30 already ran today (mismatch window duplicate); a pending
        # 13:15 row must not re-run the same symbol the same day.
        _add_task(
            migration_db,
            "u4",
            "600519.SH",
            "14:30",
            last_run_date="2026-08-19",
            last_run_status="success",
        )
        _add_task(migration_db, "u4", "600519.SH", "13:15")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert [t.user_id for t in tasks if t.user_id == "u4"] == []

    def test_disabled_intraday_that_ran_today_still_suppresses(
        self, migration_db
    ):
        # The run-state signal lives on the row, not on its active flag.
        _add_task(
            migration_db,
            "u5",
            "600519.SH",
            "14:30",
            is_active=False,
            last_run_date="2026-08-19",
            last_run_status="success",
        )
        _add_task(migration_db, "u5", "600519.SH", "13:15")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert [t.user_id for t in tasks if t.user_id == "u5"] == []

    def test_failed_intraday_attempt_today_counts_as_run(self, migration_db):
        # mark_run_failed also sets last_run_date: no same-day retry via a
        # sibling row.
        _add_task(
            migration_db,
            "u6",
            "600519.SH",
            "13:15",
            last_run_date="2026-08-19",
            last_run_status="failed",
            consecutive_failures=1,
        )
        _add_task(migration_db, "u6", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert [t.user_id for t in tasks if t.user_id == "u6"] == []

    def test_failure_deactivated_row_is_never_reactivated(self, migration_db):
        # [P1 round3] A row auto-deactivated after 3 failures stays
        # inactive; the healthy sibling keeps the symbol covered on the
        # next day without any state being copied or reset.
        _add_task(
            migration_db,
            "u7",
            "600519.SH",
            "13:15",
            is_active=False,
            last_run_date="2026-08-18",
            last_run_status="failed",
            consecutive_failures=3,
        )
        _add_task(migration_db, "u7", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        # Today nothing ran yet: the healthy 14:30 row is claimed.
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert [t.trigger_time for t in tasks if t.user_id == "u7"] == ["14:30"]
        deactivated = (
            migration_db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
            .filter_by(user_id="u7", trigger_time="13:15")
            .one()
        )
        assert deactivated.is_active is False
        assert deactivated.consecutive_failures == 3

    def test_post_close_checkpoint_unaffected(self, migration_db):
        # 20:00 always remains claimable regardless of intraday history.
        _add_task(
            migration_db,
            "u8",
            "600519.SH",
            "13:15",
            last_run_date="2026-08-19",
            last_run_status="success",
        )
        _add_task(migration_db, "u8", "600519.SH", "20:00")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u8b", "000001.SZ", "20:00")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "20:30")
        assert [(t.user_id, t.trigger_time) for t in tasks] == [
            ("u8", "20:00"),
            ("u8b", "20:00"),
        ]

    def test_intraday_dedup_is_per_user_and_symbol(self, migration_db):
        _add_task(migration_db, "u9a", "600519.SH", "13:15")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u9a", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u9a", "000001.SZ", "14:30")
        _add_task(migration_db, "u9b", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
        assert sorted((t.user_id, t.trigger_time) for t in tasks) == [
            ("u9a", "13:15"),  # pair deduped to the unified default
            ("u9a", "14:30"),  # different symbol, no pair: exact semantics
            ("u9b", "14:30"),  # different user, no pair: exact semantics
        ]


class TestNoDuplicateTasksAfterMigration:
    def test_auto_import_does_not_duplicate_legacy_intraday(
        self, migration_db
    ):
        # User auto-imported positions under the old 14:30 default. The lone
        # 14:30 row is never rewritten, and the ensure() intraday guard —
        # not a row rewrite — prevents the duplicate: re-import reports the
        # symbol as covered and creates nothing new.
        _add_task(migration_db, "user-import", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        _add_task(migration_db, "user-import", "600519.SH", "20:00")

        result = scheduled_service.ensure_scheduled_for_symbols(
            db=migration_db,
            user_id="user-import",
            symbols=["600519.SH"],
        )
        migration_db.commit()

        assert result["created"] == []
        assert result["existing"] == ["600519.SH", "600519.SH"]
        assert _states(migration_db, "user-import", "600519.SH") == {
            "14:30": True,
            "20:00": True,
        }

    def test_auto_import_guard_covers_any_intraday_time(self, migration_db):
        # An 11:35 checkpoint equally satisfies the intraday default.
        _add_task(migration_db, "user-cover", "600519.SH", "11:35")
        result = scheduled_service.ensure_scheduled_for_symbols(
            db=migration_db,
            user_id="user-cover",
            symbols=["600519.SH"],
        )
        migration_db.commit()
        assert result["created"] == ["600519.SH"]  # only 20:00 added
        assert _states(migration_db, "user-cover", "600519.SH") == {
            "11:35": True,
            "20:00": True,
        }

    def test_auto_import_guard_respects_disabled_intraday_task(
        self, migration_db
    ):
        # A disabled intraday task still counts as covered: the auto path
        # must not silently re-enable intraday analysis the user turned off.
        _add_task(
            migration_db, "user-off", "600519.SH", "14:30", is_active=False
        )
        result = scheduled_service.ensure_scheduled_for_symbols(
            db=migration_db,
            user_id="user-off",
            symbols=["600519.SH"],
        )
        migration_db.commit()
        assert result["created"] == ["600519.SH"]  # only 20:00 added
        assert _states(migration_db, "user-off", "600519.SH") == {
            "14:30": False,
            "20:00": True,
        }

    def test_auto_import_with_existing_pair_creates_nothing(
        self, migration_db
    ):
        # Mismatch-window pair: exact-key matching already covers 13:15,
        # the intraday guard is irrelevant, and 20:00 exists — nothing new.
        _add_task(migration_db, "user-pair", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        _add_task(migration_db, "user-pair", "600519.SH", "13:15")
        _add_task(migration_db, "user-pair", "600519.SH", "20:00")

        result = scheduled_service.ensure_scheduled_for_symbols(
            db=migration_db,
            user_id="user-pair",
            symbols=["600519.SH"],
        )
        migration_db.commit()

        assert result["created"] == []
        assert result["existing"] == ["600519.SH", "600519.SH"]
        assert _states(migration_db, "user-pair", "600519.SH") == {
            "13:15": True,
            "14:30": True,
            "20:00": True,
        }

    def test_explicit_trigger_time_keeps_exact_semantics(
        self, migration_db
    ):
        # The fuzzy intraday guard applies only to the defaults; an explicit
        # trigger_time request still uses exact-(symbol, time) matching.
        _add_task(migration_db, "user-explicit", "600519.SH", "14:30")
        result = scheduled_service.ensure_scheduled_for_symbols(
            db=migration_db,
            user_id="user-explicit",
            symbols=["600519.SH"],
            trigger_time="11:35",
        )
        migration_db.commit()
        assert result["created"] == ["600519.SH"]
        assert _states(migration_db, "user-explicit", "600519.SH") == {
            "11:35": True,
            "14:30": True,
        }

   144	    symbol: str,
   145	    horizon: str = "short",
   146	    trigger_time: str = "20:00",

   148	    """Create a scheduled analysis task."""

   165	    )
   166	    db.add(item)

   172	def ensure_scheduled_for_symbols(
   173	    db: Session,
   174	    user_id: str,
   175	    symbols: Iterable[str],
   176	    horizon: str = "short",
   177	    trigger_time: str | Iterable[str] | None = None,
   178	) -> dict:
   179	    """Ensure the given symbols exist in scheduled tasks without duplicating existing items."""
   180	
   181	    horizon = _validate_horizon(horizon)
   182	    if trigger_time is None:
   183	        trigger_times = list(DEFAULT_SCHEDULED_TRIGGER_TIMES)
   184	    elif isinstance(trigger_time, str):
   185	        trigger_times = [_validate_trigger_time(trigger_time)]
   186	    else:
   187	        trigger_times = [_validate_trigger_time(item) for item in trigger_time]
   188	    if not trigger_times:
   189	        trigger_times = list(DEFAULT_SCHEDULED_TRIGGER_TIMES)
   190	
   191	    existing_items = (
   192	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   193	        .filter(ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id == user_id)
   194	        .order_by(ScheduledAnalysisDB.created_at)
   195	        .all()
   196	    )
   197	    existing_keys = {(item.symbol, item.trigger_time or "20:00") for item in existing_items}
   198	    remaining_slots = max(0, MAX_SCHEDULED_ITEMS - len(existing_items))
   199	    # [CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] Intraday guard for the auto path: a symbol
   200	    # that already has ANY intraday task (active or not — e.g. a legacy
   201	    # 14:30 row whose auto/user origin cannot be distinguished) is covered;
   202	    # the default intraday checkpoint must not duplicate it into a second
   203	    # paid analysis. Applies only when the defaults are in use; explicit
   204	    # trigger_time requests keep exact-(symbol, time) semantics.
   205	    using_defaults = tuple(trigger_times) == tuple(DEFAULT_SCHEDULED_TRIGGER_TIMES)
   206	    intraday_covered_symbols = {
   207	        item.symbol
   208	        for item in existing_items
   209	        if (item.trigger_time or "20:00") < _INTRADAY_COVERED_CUTOFF
   210	    }
   211	
   212	    created: list[str] = []
   213	    existing: list[str] = []
   214	    skipped_limit: list[str] = []
   215	    seen: set[str] = set()
   216	
   217	    for raw_symbol in symbols:
   218	        symbol = (raw_symbol or "").strip().upper()
   219	        if not symbol or symbol in seen:
   220	            continue
   221	        seen.add(symbol)
   222	
   223	        for trigger_time_item in trigger_times:
   224	            key = (symbol, trigger_time_item)
   225	            if key in existing_keys:
   226	                existing.append(symbol)
   227	                continue
   228	
   229	            if (
   230	                using_defaults
   231	                and trigger_time_item < _INTRADAY_COVERED_CUTOFF
   232	                and symbol in intraday_covered_symbols
   233	            ):
   234	                existing.append(symbol)
   235	                continue
   236	
   237	            if remaining_slots <= 0:
   238	                skipped_limit.append(symbol)
   239	                continue
   240	
   241	            db.add(
   242	                ScheduledAnalysisDB(
   243	                    id=uuid4().hex,
   244	                    user_id=user_id,
   245	                    symbol=symbol,
   246	                    horizon=horizon,
   247	                    trigger_time=trigger_time_item,
   248	                )
   249	            )
   250	            existing_keys.add(key)
   251	            created.append(symbol)
   252	            remaining_slots -= 1
   253	
   254	    if created:
   255	        db.flush()
   256	
   257	    return {
   258	        "created": created,
   259	        "existing": existing,
   260	        "skipped_limit": skipped_limit,
   261	    }

   264	def update_scheduled(db: Session, user_id: str, item_id: str, **kwargs) -> Optional[dict]:
   265	    """Update a scheduled analysis task. Returns None if not found."""
   266	    item = (
   267	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   268	        .filter(ScheduledAnalysisDB.id == item_id, ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id == user_id)
   269	        .first()
   270	    )
   271	    if not item:
   272	        return None
   273	
   274	    next_trigger_time = _validate_trigger_time(kwargs["trigger_time"]) if "trigger_time" in kwargs else (item.trigger_time or "20:00")
   275	    if "trigger_time" in kwargs:
   276	        _ensure_no_schedule_conflict(db, user_id, item.symbol, next_trigger_time, exclude_id=item.id)
   277	    _apply_scheduled_updates(item, **kwargs)
   278	
   279	    db.commit()
   280	    db.refresh(item)
   281	    return _to_dict(item)

   284	def batch_update_scheduled(
   285	    db: Session,
   286	    user_id: str,
   287	    item_ids: Iterable[str],
   288	    **kwargs,
   289	) -> List[dict]:
   290	    """Update multiple scheduled analysis tasks in a single transaction."""
   291	
   292	    normalized_ids = _normalize_item_ids(item_ids)
   293	    if not normalized_ids:
   294	        raise ValueError("请至少选择一个定时任务")
   295	    if not kwargs:
   296	        raise ValueError("至少提供一个更新字段")
   297	
   298	    items = (
   299	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   300	        .filter(
   301	            ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id == user_id,
   302	            ScheduledAnalysisDB.id.in_(normalized_ids),
   303	        )
   304	        .all()
   305	    )
   306	    item_map = {item.id: item for item in items}
   307	    missing_ids = [item_id for item_id in normalized_ids if item_id not in item_map]
   308	    if missing_ids:
   309	        raise ValueError("部分定时任务不存在或已失效，请刷新后重试")
   310	
   311	    if "trigger_time" in kwargs:
   312	        next_trigger_time = _validate_trigger_time(kwargs["trigger_time"])
   313	        seen_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
   314	        for item_id in normalized_ids:
   315	            item = item_map[item_id]
   316	            key = (item.symbol, next_trigger_time)
   317	            if key in seen_keys:
   318	                raise ValueError(f"{item.symbol} 在 {next_trigger_time} 已有定时分析任务")
   319	            seen_keys.add(key)
   320	            _ensure_no_schedule_conflict(db, user_id, item.symbol, next_trigger_time, exclude_id=item.id)
   321	
   322	    for item_id in normalized_ids:
   323	        _apply_scheduled_updates(item_map[item_id], **kwargs)
   324	
   325	    db.commit()
   326	    for item in items:
   327	        db.refresh(item)
   328	    return [_to_dict(item_map[item_id]) for item_id in normalized_ids]
   329	
   330	
   331	def delete_scheduled(db: Session, user_id: str, item_id: str) -> bool:
   332	    """Delete a scheduled analysis task."""
   333	    item = (
   334	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   335	        .filter(ScheduledAnalysisDB.id == item_id, ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id == user_id)
   336	        .first()
   337	    )
   338	    if not item:
   339	        return False
   340	    db.delete(item)
   341	    db.commit()
   342	    return True
   343	
   344	
   345	def batch_delete_scheduled(db: Session, user_id: str, item_ids: Iterable[str]) -> dict:
   346	    """Delete multiple scheduled analysis tasks."""
   347	
   348	    normalized_ids = _normalize_item_ids(item_ids)
   349	    if not normalized_ids:
   350	        raise ValueError("请至少选择一个定时任务")
   351	
   352	    items = (
   353	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   354	        .filter(
   355	            ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id == user_id,
   356	            ScheduledAnalysisDB.id.in_(normalized_ids),
   357	        )
   358	        .all()
   359	    )
   360	    item_map = {item.id: item for item in items}
   361	    deleted_ids: list[str] = []
   362	    missing_ids: list[str] = []
   363	
   364	    for item_id in normalized_ids:
   365	        item = item_map.get(item_id)
   366	        if item is None:
   367	            missing_ids.append(item_id)
   368	            continue
   369	        db.delete(item)
   370	        deleted_ids.append(item_id)
   371	
   372	    if deleted_ids:
   373	        db.commit()
   374	
   375	    return {
   376	        "deleted_ids": deleted_ids,
   377	        "missing_ids": missing_ids,
   378	    }

   380	
   381	def get_pending_tasks(db: Session, today: str, current_hhmm: str) -> List[ScheduledAnalysisDB]:
   382	    """Get all active tasks that haven't run today and whose trigger time has passed.
   383	
   384	    Only returns tasks for real (non-test) users to avoid duplicate runs
   385	    from dashboard test accounts.
   386	
   387	    [CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] Default-pair claim dedup — scoped to exactly the
   388	    legacy default collision {13:15, 14:30} created by the historical
   389	    frontend/backend default mismatch. Such pairs cannot be retroactively
   390	    classified as auto-created vs user-chosen, so no row is rewritten or
   391	    deactivated; instead the scheduler claims at most one of the two per
   392	    (user_id, symbol) per day (the earlier 13:15 first) and claims neither
   393	    once one of them — active or disabled, including a failed attempt —
   394	    already ran today. Every other scheduling combination (e.g. a
   395	    deliberate 11:35 + 14:30, or any non-default time) keeps exact-time
   396	    semantics.
   397	    """
   398	    from api.database import UserDB
   399	
   400	    # Exclude dashboard test accounts (@test.com) to prevent
   401	    # 452 test users from triggering duplicate scheduled runs.
   402	    # Users NOT in the users table (e.g. test fixtures) are kept.
   403	    test_user_ids = (
   404	        db.query(UserDB.id)
   405	        .filter(UserDB.email.like("%@test.com"))
   406	        .subquery()
   407	    )
   408	
   409	    all_active = (
   410	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   411	        .filter(
   412	            ScheduledAnalysisDB.is_active == True,
   413	            ~ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id.in_(sqlalchemy.select(test_user_ids)),
   414	            (ScheduledAnalysisDB.last_run_date != today) | (ScheduledAnalysisDB.last_run_date == None),
   415	        )
   416	        .all()
   417	    )
   418	
   419	    # All rows (including disabled ones) for the default-pair analysis: a
   420	    # disabled row that already ran today still means the symbol consumed
   421	    # its daily intraday default slot.
   422	    all_rows = (
   423	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   424	        .filter(
   425	            ~ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id.in_(sqlalchemy.select(test_user_ids))
   426	        )
   427	        .all()
   428	    )
   429	    pair_times = (
   430	        DEFAULT_SCHEDULED_TRIGGER_TIMES[0],
   431	        LEGACY_DEFAULT_INTRADAY_TRIGGER_TIME,
   432	    )
   433	    default_pair_keys = {
   434	        (t.user_id, t.symbol)
   435	        for t in all_rows
   436	        if t.trigger_time == pair_times[0]
   437	    } & {
   438	        (t.user_id, t.symbol)
   439	        for t in all_rows
   440	        if t.trigger_time == pair_times[1]
   441	    }
   442	    pair_ran_today = {
   443	        (t.user_id, t.symbol)
   444	        for t in all_rows
   445	        if t.last_run_date == today and t.trigger_time in pair_times
   446	    }
   447	
   448	    # Filter by trigger_time <= current_hhmm
   449	    pending = [t for t in all_active if (t.trigger_time or "20:00") <= current_hhmm]
   450	
   451	    claimed_pair: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
   452	    result: list[ScheduledAnalysisDB] = []
   453	    # Earliest checkpoint first so the dedup prefers the unified 13:15 task
   454	    # over its legacy 14:30 sibling.
   455	    for task in sorted(pending, key=lambda t: t.trigger_time or "20:00"):
   456	        if (task.trigger_time or "20:00") in pair_times:
   457	            key = (task.user_id, task.symbol)
   458	            if key in default_pair_keys:
   459	                if key in pair_ran_today or key in claimed_pair:
   460	                    continue
   461	                claimed_pair.add(key)
   462	        result.append(task)
   463	    return result
   464	
   465	
   466	def mark_run_success(db: Session, item_id: str, trade_date: str, report_id: str):
   467	    """Mark a scheduled task as successfully run."""
   468	    item = db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB).filter(ScheduledAnalysisDB.id == item_id).first()
   469	    if item:
   470	        item.last_run_date = trade_date
   471	        item.last_run_status = "success"
   472	        item.last_report_id = report_id
   473	        item.consecutive_failures = 0
   474	        db.commit()
   475	
   476	
   477	def mark_run_failed(db: Session, item_id: str, trade_date: str):
   478	    """Mark a scheduled task as failed. Auto-deactivate after 3 consecutive failures."""
   479	    item = db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB).filter(ScheduledAnalysisDB.id == item_id).first()
   480	    if item:
   481	        item.last_run_date = trade_date
   482	        item.last_run_status = "failed"
   483	        item.consecutive_failures = (item.consecutive_failures or 0) + 1
   484	        if item.consecutive_failures >= 3:
   485	            item.is_active = False
   486	        db.commit()
   487

--- project-overview ---
# 项目说明

## 项目定位

TradingAgents-AShare 是一个面向 A 股投资者的多智能体投研系统，核心理念：

- **模拟真实投研机构**：14 个专业角色分工协作
- **多空辩论机制**：多头研究员 vs 空头研究员，研究总监裁决
- **多模型厂商支持**：OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / 智谱 / DeepSeek / 小米等
- **意图驱动交互**：自然语言输入，自动识别标的和周期
- **持仓追踪**：导入持仓，自动跟踪，连续分析

## 当前产品事实（2026-07-10）

项目已从单一报告生成器扩展为分层投研工作台，但产品主线应保持收敛：

```text
Tree Work 既有研报/半年报知识页（历史上游）
  -> ZCode 知识库接入、研究评分与快照发布
  -> 来源与事实审计
  -> 昊天左侧候选
  -> TradeFlow 少量候选池
  -> 轻量 TA / 人工确认的完整 TA
  -> 观察仓、盘中观察、盘后复盘
```

TradeFlow 的 `TECH_TRADE` 与 `POLICY_AMBUSH/POLICY_CONFIRM` 必须分池展示，不能把短线技术机会当作中长期昊天候选。Fast Radar、Light Research、Full TA 的运行层级也必须保持清晰：完整 TA 只能人工确认触发。

现有 Tree Work 知识页只作为可追溯的历史上游与背景/观点证据；后续知识库接入、`research-scorer` 和正式快照发布统一由 ZCode 负责。公告、原始财报和行情数据仍是事实与动作门禁的优先来源。所有知识命中都必须带来源路径、报告期或更新时间、来源等级和新鲜度。

## 核心架构

### 1. 分析师团队（7 个）

| 角色 | 职责 | 数据源 |
|------|------|--------|
| 基本面分析师 | 财务指标、估值分析 | Tushare Pro（结构化主源）/AKShare/BaoStock |
| 情绪分析师 | 社交媒体情绪、舆情 | AKShare |
| 新闻分析师 | 新闻事件、政策影响 | AKShare |
| 技术分析师 | K线形态、技术指标 | AKShare/BaoStock |
| 宏观分析师 | 宏观经济、利率环境 | AKShare |
| 主力资金分析师 | 大单流向、主力动向 | Tushare Pro（个股资金主源）/AKShare |
| 量价分析师 | 成交量、量价关系 | AKShare/BaoStock |

### 2. 研究员团队

- **多头研究员**：综合分析师结论，构建看多 Claim
- **空头研究员**：综合分析师结论，构建看空 Claim
- **研究总监**：裁决多空辩论，形成投资计划

### 3. 风控团队

- **风控经理**：评估风险、设置止损止盈
- **合规检查**：确保建议符合投资规范

### 4. 交易员

- 根据研究计划和风控要求，输出最终交易建议

### 5. 编排层

- **LangGraph**：状态图编排，控制 Agent 间信息流转
- **辩论机制**：多轮辩论，每轮有 Claim → Counter-Claim → 裁决

## 数据流

```
用户输入（自然语言）
  ↓
意图识别 → 标的 + 周期
  ↓
数据获取（7 路并行）
  ↓
分析师团队（7 个并行分析）
  ↓
研究员辩论（多轮）
  ↓
风控评估
  ↓
交易建议输出
  ↓
研报存储 + 通知推送
```

## 模型配置

系统支持多层模型配置：

| 配置项 | 说明 | 默认值 |
|--------|------|--------|
| `deep_think_llm` | 深度思考模型 | gpt-4o |
| `quick_think_llm` | 快速思考模型 | gpt-4o-mini |
| `mid_think_llm` | 中等思考模型 | gpt-4o |
| `ultra_think_llm` | 超深度思考模型 | gpt-4o |
| `backend_url` | API 端点 | https://api.openai.com/v1 |

支持通过环境变量或前端设置页切换模型厂商。

## API 接口

后端 FastAPI 提供以下主要接口：

- `POST /api/analyze` — 启动分析任务
- `GET /api/analysis/{id}` — 获取分析结果
- `GET /api/holdings` — 获取持仓
- `POST /api/watchlist` — 管理自选股
- `GET /api/reports` — 历史研报
- `POST /api/scheduler` — 定时任务管理

## 前端功能

- 意图驱动的自然语言交互
- 辩论对战可视化（多空对抗 Drawer）
- 持仓追踪与跟踪看板
- 结构化研报管理
- 定时分析配置
- 模型厂商设置

### G-006: 报告原始证据快照落库与可追溯数据质量状态（P0） ✅ 已完成
- **描述**：每份 TA 报告必须保存本次分析实际使用的原始证据快照，支持事后核查行情、资金、龙虎榜、新闻、财报到底来自哪个源、是否失败、是否过期。

- **状态**：done

- **实现要点**：

### G-007: 资金流与龙虎榜数据源口径校验（P1） ✅ 已完成
- **描述**：修复"主力资金报告说缺失，但下游仍把主力净流出当强证据"的口径冲突；龙虎榜必须区分未查询、无触发、查询失败、有数据。
- **背景**：600584.SH 报告中 `smart_money_report` 明确写近20日主力资金 ProxyError、龙虎榜未触发，但研究经理/交易员仍多次使用"主力资金净流出"作为强证据，且将 5月22日龙虎榜事实与 5月26日未查询混在一起。
- **优先级**：P1
- **状态**：done
- **执行约束**：
  - 不把新闻中的“资金流向日报”直接等同于个股主力资金接口。
  - 个股资金、板块资金、新闻转述资金必须分字段记录，禁止混用。
  - 修改后更新 `docs/DEVLOG.md`。

  1. `extract_execution_signals` 或研究经理输入中加入资金源类型：`individual_fund_flow`、`board_fund_flow`、`news_reported_fund_flow`。
  2. 只有 `individual_fund_flow.status == HAS_DATA` 且单位校验通过，才允许作为“主力资金”强证据。
  3. `lhb` 状态细分：`HAS_DATA / NOT_QUERIED / NORMAL_NO_DATA / FAILED`。
  4. 下游冲突摘要必须指出“资金流接口失败，新闻转述资金仅作弱证据”。
- **验证方式**：
  - 构造资金流接口失败 + 新闻中出现“主力净流出”，最终强动作门禁不得把它当主力资金强证据。
  - 龙虎榜 `force=False` 时底部显示 `NOT_QUERIED`，不显示“无显著资金异动”。
  - 龙虎榜历史有数据但当日未查时，不得说“无龙虎榜数据”。
- **代码标注要求**：`# [G-007] fund_lhb_provenance`

### G-008: 估值 sanity check 与旧价污染拦截（P1）
- **描述**：修复基本面报告中用旧股价/假设股价计算市值和 PE 的问题，禁止在已有最新行情价时使用过期假设价格。
- **背景**：600584.SH 报告中一边使用 80.17 的行情，一边在基本面估值处使用“股价假设30元”计算总市值和 PE，导致 PE 从约90倍级别错写为36倍。
- **优先级**：P1
- **状态**：done（已由 `G-010` 补修并通过正式测试）
- **执行约束**：
  - 不改 prompt 作为唯一方案，优先在 readiness/quality 层做 deterministic sanity check。
  - 修改后更新 `docs/DEVLOG.md`。
- **实现要点**：
  1. 从 raw evidence/latest quote 中提取最新价格，作为估值计算基准。
  2. 若报告中出现“假设股价/约X元”且与最新价格偏离超过 20%，标记 `valuation_stale_price_conflict`。
  3. 出现该冲突时，基本面估值结论降权，Confidence 下调，不允许输出“估值合理/安全边际高”等强表述。
  4. 报告底部执行质检列出冲突：`估值价格与行情价格不一致`。
- **验证方式**：
  - 构造最新价 80、报告估值用 30，断言触发冲突。

## 模型配置

系统支持多层模型配置：

| 配置项 | 说明 | 默认值 |
|--------|------|--------|
| `deep_think_llm` | 深度思考模型 | gpt-4o |
| `quick_think_llm` | 快速思考模型 | gpt-4o-mini |
| `mid_think_llm` | 中等思考模型 | gpt-4o |
| `ultra_think_llm` | 超深度思考模型 | gpt-4o |
| `backend_url` | API 端点 | https://api.openai.com/v1 |

支持通过环境变量或前端设置页切换模型厂商。

## API 接口

后端 FastAPI 提供以下主要接口：

- `POST /api/analyze` — 启动分析任务
- `GET /api/analysis/{id}` — 获取分析结果
- `GET /api/holdings` — 获取持仓
- `POST /api/watchlist` — 管理自选股
- `GET /api/reports` — 历史研报
- `POST /api/scheduler` — 定时任务管理

Full review comments:

- [P1] Preserve intentional 13:15/14:30 schedule pairs — /Users/maybee/TradingAgents-AShare/api/database.py:491-497
  When a user deliberately configured both 13:15 and 14:30 before the first upgraded startup, this migration unconditionally deactivates the 14:30 task. `create_scheduled` and `update_scheduled` explicitly support multiple arbitrary daily times, and these rows have no provenance proving they came from automatic import, so this silently removes a valid user-requested analysis.

- [P1] Do not reactivate schedules past the failure cutoff — /Users/maybee/TradingAgents-AShare/api/database.py:476-479
  When either member of a duplicate pair was auto-deactivated after three failures while the other remains active, the migration copies `max(consecutive_failures)` but forcibly sets the survivor active. This produces an active row with three failures, and because `get_pending_tasks` does not filter by failure count, it is dispatched again on the next day despite the established auto-deactivation guard.
The focused tests pass, but the migration can silently disable legitimate user schedules and can reactivate schedules that reached the automatic failure cutoff. Both affect production scheduler behavior and potentially paid analyses.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Preserve intentional 13:15/14:30 schedule pairs — /Users/maybee/TradingAgents-AShare/api/database.py:491-497
  When a user deliberately configured both 13:15 and 14:30 before the first upgraded startup, this migration unconditionally deactivates the 14:30 task. `create_scheduled` and `update_scheduled` explicitly support multiple arbitrary daily times, and these rows have no provenance proving they came from automatic import, so this silently removes a valid user-requested analysis.

- [P1] Do not reactivate schedules past the failure cutoff — /Users/maybee/TradingAgents-AShare/api/database.py:476-479
  When either member of a duplicate pair was auto-deactivated after three failures while the other remains active, the migration copies `max(consecutive_failures)` but forcibly sets the survivor active. This produces an active row with three failures, and because `get_pending_tasks` does not filter by failure count, it is dispatched again on the next day despite the established auto-deactivation guard.

   190	def _add_task(
   191	    db,
   192	    user_id,
   193	    symbol,
   194	    trigger_time,
   195	    created_at="2026-08-01 10:00:00",
   196	    is_active=True,
   197	    **extra,
   198	):
   199	    from uuid import uuid4
   200	
   201	    if isinstance(created_at, str):
   202	        created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at)
   203	    db.add(
   204	        ScheduledAnalysisDB(
   205	            id=uuid4().hex,
   206	            user_id=user_id,
   207	            symbol=symbol,
   208	            horizon="short",
   209	            trigger_time=trigger_time,
   210	            is_active=is_active,
   211	            created_at=created_at,
   212	            **extra,
   213	        )
   214	    )
   215	    db.commit()
   216

   218	def _states(db, user_id, symbol):
   219	    rows = (
   220	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   221	        .filter(
   222	            ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id == user_id,
   223	            ScheduledAnalysisDB.symbol == symbol,
   224	        )
   225	        .all()
   226	    )
   227	    return {row.trigger_time: bool(row.is_active) for row in rows}

   230	class TestSchedulerIntradayClaimDedup:
   231	    """[CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] get_pending_tasks dedups ONLY the exact
   232	    legacy default pair {13:15, 14:30} created by the frontend/backend
   233	    default mismatch — the pair cannot be retroactively classified as
   234	    auto-created vs user-chosen, so no row is rewritten; the scheduler just
   235	    claims at most one of the two per (user, symbol) per day. Every other
   236	    combination keeps exact-time semantics."""
   237	
   238	    def test_pair_claims_only_earliest_intraday(self, migration_db):
   239	        # The frontend/backend mismatch pair: both rows active, none ran.
   240	        _add_task(migration_db, "u1", "600519.SH", "14:30")
   241	        _add_task(migration_db, "u1", "600519.SH", "13:15")
   242	        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
   243	        assert [t.trigger_time for t in tasks] == ["13:15"]
   244	        # Nothing was rewritten: both rows stay exactly as created.
   245	        assert _states(migration_db, "u1", "600519.SH") == {
   246	            "13:15": True,
   247	            "14:30": True,
   248	        }
   249	
   250	    def test_non_default_intraday_combinations_keep_exact_semantics(
   251	        self, migration_db
   252	    ):
   253	        # [P1 round4] Deliberate multi-checkpoint setups that are not the
   254	        # default {13:15, 14:30} collision must keep running every task.
   255	        _add_task(migration_db, "u2a", "600519.SH", "11:35")
   256	        _add_task(migration_db, "u2a", "600519.SH", "14:30")
   257	        _add_task(migration_db, "u2b", "000001.SZ", "11:35")
   258	        _add_task(migration_db, "u2b", "000001.SZ", "13:15")
   259	        tasks = get_pending_tasks(migration_db, "2026-08-19", "16:00")
   260	        assert sorted((t.user_id, t.trigger_time) for t in tasks) == [
   261	            ("u2a", "11:35"),
   262	            ("u2a", "14:30"),
   263	            ("u2b", "11:35"),
   264	            ("u2b", "13:15"),
   265	        ]

    75	@dataclass
    76	class DeepTADispatcher:
    77	    trade_date: str = ""
    78	    daily_count: int = 0
    79	    daily_limit: int = 3
    80	    blocked_models: tuple = ("deepseek",)  # [CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] default block restored; explicit authorization required to lift
    81	    # [CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] DeepSeek explicit authorization is carried on the
    82	    # dispatcher itself and enforced by check_deep_ta_gate, so direct
    83	    # construction (not just from_config) cannot bypass the paid-model gate.
    84	    deepseek_authorized: bool = False
    85	    default_model: str = ""
    86	    max_retries: int = 1
    87	    min_composite_score: float = 40.0
    88	    min_completeness: float = 0.5
    89	    require_observe_triggered: bool = True
    90	    records: dict[str, DeepTARecord] = field(default_factory=dict)
    91	    failure_counts: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    92	
    93	    def __post_init__(self):
    94	        if not self.trade_date:
    95	            self.trade_date = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    97	    @classmethod
    98	    def from_config(cls, cfg: Optional[StrategyConfig] = None) -> "DeepTADispatcher":
    99	        if cfg is None:
   100	            cfg = DEFAULT_STRATEGY_CONFIG
   101	        deepseek_authorized = bool(getattr(cfg, "deep_ta_deepseek_authorized", False))
   102	        blocked_models = tuple(getattr(cfg, "deep_ta_blocked_models", ("deepseek",)))
   103	        # [CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] DeepSeek explicit authorization gate:
   104	        # - unauthorized (default): keep "deepseek" blocked even if a config
   105	        #   accidentally dropped it — fail closed, never implicitly unblocked.
   106	        # - authorized: drop only "deepseek"; every other blocked entry stays.
   107	        if deepseek_authorized:
   108	            blocked_models = tuple(
   109	                m for m in blocked_models if str(m).lower() != "deepseek"
   110	            )
   111	        elif "deepseek" not in {str(m).lower() for m in blocked_models}:
   112	            blocked_models = blocked_models + ("deepseek",)
   113	        return cls(
   114	            daily_limit=getattr(cfg, "deep_ta_daily_limit", 3),
   115	            blocked_models=blocked_models,
   116	            deepseek_authorized=deepseek_authorized,
   117	            default_model=getattr(cfg, "deep_ta_default_model", ""),
   118	            max_retries=getattr(cfg, "deep_ta_max_retries", 1),
   119	            min_composite_score=getattr(cfg, "deep_ta_min_composite_score", 40.0),
   120	            min_completeness=getattr(cfg, "deep_ta_min_completeness", 0.5),
   121	            require_observe_triggered=getattr(cfg, "deep_ta_require_observe_triggered", True),
   122	        )

   124	
   125	def check_deep_ta_gate(
   126	    dispatcher: DeepTADispatcher,
   127	    symbol: str,
   128	    need_deep_ta: bool,
   129	    observe_state: str,
   130	    composite_score: float = 0.0,
   131	    completeness: float = 0.0,
   132	    position_context: str = "unknown",
   133	    tier: str = "",
   134	    model: str = "",
   135	    retry_count: int = 0,
   136	) -> DeepTADecision:
   137	    """Check all gates before allowing a deep TA dispatch.
   138	
   139	    Returns a DeepTADecision with allowed=True only if all gates pass.
   140	    """
   141	    record = DeepTARecord(
   142	        symbol=symbol,
   143	        position_context=position_context,
   144	        composite_score=composite_score,
   145	        observe_state=observe_state,
   146	        completeness=completeness,
   147	        trade_date=dispatcher.trade_date,
   148	    )
   149	
   150	    if not need_deep_ta:
   151	        record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   152	        record.block_reason = "need_deep_ta=False"
   153	        return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason="need_deep_ta=False", record=record)
   154	
   155	    if dispatcher.daily_count >= dispatcher.daily_limit:
   156	        record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   157	        record.block_reason = f"每日次数上限({dispatcher.daily_limit}次)已满"
   158	        return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason=record.block_reason, record=record)
   159	
   160	    if dispatcher.require_observe_triggered and observe_state != "TRIGGERED":
   161	        record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   162	        record.block_reason = f"盘中观察状态非TRIGGERED(当前:{observe_state})"
   163	        return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason=record.block_reason, record=record)
   164	
   165	    if composite_score < dispatcher.min_composite_score:
   166	        record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   167	        record.block_reason = f"综合分{composite_score:.1f}低于阈值{dispatcher.min_composite_score:.1f}"
   168	        return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason=record.block_reason, record=record)
   169	
   170	    if completeness < dispatcher.min_completeness:
   171	        record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   172	        record.block_reason = f"证据完整度{completeness:.0%}低于阈值{dispatcher.min_completeness:.0%}"
   173	        return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason=record.block_reason, record=record)
   174	
   175	    resolved_model = model or dispatcher.default_model
   176	    if not resolved_model:
   177	        record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   178	        record.block_reason = "未指定模型(default_model也为空)"
   179	        return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason=record.block_reason, record=record)
   180	
   181	    model_lower = resolved_model.lower()
   182	    # [CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] DeepSeek requires explicit authorization carried
   183	    # on the dispatcher itself. Enforced here in the gate — not only in
   184	    # from_config — so direct construction with a cleared blocked_models tuple
   185	    # still cannot bypass the paid-model protection.
   186	    if "deepseek" in model_lower and not dispatcher.deepseek_authorized:
   187	        record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   188	        record.block_reason = (
   189	            f"模型'{resolved_model}'未获DeepSeek显式授权"
   190	            "(deep_ta_deepseek_authorized=False)"
   191	        )
   192	        return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason=record.block_reason, record=record)
   193	    for blocked in dispatcher.blocked_models:
   194	        if blocked and blocked.lower() in model_lower:
   195	            record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   196	            record.block_reason = f"模型'{resolved_model}'被默认屏蔽"
   197	            return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason=record.block_reason, record=record)
   198	
   199	    sym_failures = dispatcher.failure_counts.get(symbol, 0)
   200	    if sym_failures + retry_count > dispatcher.max_retries:
   201	        record.status = DeepTAStatus.BLOCKED
   202	        record.block_reason = f"失败次数({sym_failures + retry_count})超过最大重试({dispatcher.max_retries})"
   203	        return DeepTADecision(allowed=False, reason=record.block_reason, record=record)
   204	
   205	    if not position_context or position_context == "unknown":
   206	        record.position_context = "unknown"
   207	
   208	    record.status = DeepTAStatus.PENDING
   209	    record.model = resolved_model
   210	    record.retry_count = retry_count
   211	
   212	    reason_parts = [
   213	        f"综合分{composite_score:.1f}",
   214	        f"完整度{completeness:.0%}",
   215	        f"观察状态={observe_state}",
   216	        f"持仓={position_context}",
   217	    ]
   218	    if tier:
   219	        reason_parts.append(f"分层={tier}")
   220	    if retry_count > 0:
   221	        reason_parts.append(f"重试#{retry_count}")
   222	
   223	    return DeepTADecision(
   224	        allowed=True,
   225	        reason="; ".join(reason_parts),
   226	        model=resolved_model,
   227	        record=record,
   228	    )

   381	def get_pending_tasks(db: Session, today: str, current_hhmm: str) -> List[ScheduledAnalysisDB]:
   382	    """Get all active tasks that haven't run today and whose trigger time has passed.
   383	
   384	    Only returns tasks for real (non-test) users to avoid duplicate runs
   385	    from dashboard test accounts.
   386	
   387	    [CONFIG-DS-SCHEDULE-R1] Default-pair claim dedup — scoped to exactly the
   388	    legacy default collision {13:15, 14:30} created by the historical
   389	    frontend/backend default mismatch. Such pairs cannot be retroactively
   390	    classified as auto-created vs user-chosen, so no row is rewritten or
   391	    deactivated; instead the scheduler claims at most one of the two per
   392	    (user_id, symbol) per day (the earlier 13:15 first) and claims neither
   393	    once one of them — active or disabled, including a failed attempt —
   394	    already ran today. Every other scheduling combination (e.g. a
   395	    deliberate 11:35 + 14:30, or any non-default time) keeps exact-time
   396	    semantics.
   397	    """
   398	    from api.database import UserDB
   399	
   400	    # Exclude dashboard test accounts (@test.com) to prevent
   401	    # 452 test users from triggering duplicate scheduled runs.
   402	    # Users NOT in the users table (e.g. test fixtures) are kept.
   403	    test_user_ids = (
   404	        db.query(UserDB.id)
   405	        .filter(UserDB.email.like("%@test.com"))
   406	        .subquery()
   407	    )
   408	
   409	    all_active = (
   410	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   411	        .filter(
   412	            ScheduledAnalysisDB.is_active == True,
   413	            ~ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id.in_(sqlalchemy.select(test_user_ids)),
   414	            (ScheduledAnalysisDB.last_run_date != today) | (ScheduledAnalysisDB.last_run_date == None),
   415	        )
   416	        .all()
   417	    )
   418	
   419	    # All rows (including disabled ones) for the default-pair analysis: a
   420	    # disabled row that already ran today still means the symbol consumed
   421	    # its daily intraday default slot.
   422	    all_rows = (
   423	        db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB)
   424	        .filter(
   425	            ~ScheduledAnalysisDB.user_id.in_(sqlalchemy.select(test_user_ids))
   426	        )
   427	        .all()
   428	    )
   429	    pair_times = (
   430	        DEFAULT_SCHEDULED_TRIGGER_TIMES[0],
   431	        LEGACY_DEFAULT_INTRADAY_TRIGGER_TIME,
   432	    )
   433	    default_pair_keys = {
   434	        (t.user_id, t.symbol)
   435	        for t in all_rows
   436	        if t.trigger_time == pair_times[0]
   437	    } & {
   438	        (t.user_id, t.symbol)
   439	        for t in all_rows
   440	        if t.trigger_time == pair_times[1]
   441	    }
   442	    pair_ran_today = {
   443	        (t.user_id, t.symbol)
   444	        for t in all_rows
   445	        if t.last_run_date == today and t.trigger_time in pair_times
   446	    }
   447	
   448	    # Filter by trigger_time <= current_hhmm
   449	    pending = [t for t in all_active if (t.trigger_time or "20:00") <= current_hhmm]
   450	
   451	    claimed_pair: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
   452	    result: list[ScheduledAnalysisDB] = []
   453	    # Earliest checkpoint first so the dedup prefers the unified 13:15 task
   454	    # over its legacy 14:30 sibling.
   455	    for task in sorted(pending, key=lambda t: t.trigger_time or "20:00"):
   456	        if (task.trigger_time or "20:00") in pair_times:
   457	            key = (task.user_id, task.symbol)
   458	            if key in default_pair_keys:
   459	                if key in pair_ran_today or key in claimed_pair:
   460	                    continue
   461	                claimed_pair.add(key)
   462	        result.append(task)
   463	    return result
   464	
   465	
   466	def mark_run_success(db: Session, item_id: str, trade_date: str, report_id: str):
   467	    """Mark a scheduled task as successfully run."""
   468	    item = db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB).filter(ScheduledAnalysisDB.id == item_id).first()
   469	    if item:
   470	        item.last_run_date = trade_date
   471	        item.last_run_status = "success"
   472	        item.last_report_id = report_id
   473	        item.consecutive_failures = 0
   474	        db.commit()
   475	
   476	
   477	def mark_run_failed(db: Session, item_id: str, trade_date: str):
   478	    """Mark a scheduled task as failed. Auto-deactivate after 3 consecutive failures."""
   479	    item = db.query(ScheduledAnalysisDB).filter(ScheduledAnalysisDB.id == item_id).first()
   480	    if item:
   481	        item.last_run_date = trade_date
   482	        item.last_run_status = "failed"
   483	        item.consecutive_failures = (item.consecutive_failures or 0) + 1
   484	        if item.consecutive_failures >= 3:
   485	            item.is_active = False

codex
Focused tests pass, but the scheduler can silently skip allowed or semantically distinct scheduled analyses. The implementation record also describes a database migration that no longer exists.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Apply the allowlist before pair deduplication — /Users/maybee/TradingAgents-AShare/api/services/scheduled_service.py:455-460
  When `SCHEDULER_ALLOWED_TRIGGER_TIMES` contains only `14:30` and both 13:15/14:30 rows exist, this always selects 13:15 and discards 14:30. `scheduler/main.py` applies the allowlist only after this function returns, so it then drops 13:15 and claims neither task; choose the surviving pair member after applying the allowlist.

- [P1] Include horizon in the deduplication key — /Users/maybee/TradingAgents-AShare/api/services/scheduled_service.py:433-440
  When the same symbol is deliberately scheduled as `short` at 13:15 and `medium` at 14:30, both configurations are accepted by the create/update API, but this key conflates them and the later horizon never executes. Different-horizon analyses are not duplicate defaults, so the deduplication identity must preserve horizon or reliable schedule provenance.

- [P2] Remove stale migration claims from DEVLOG — /Users/maybee/TradingAgents-AShare/docs/DEVLOG.md:20-22
  The current patch contains no `_migrate_scheduled_intraday_trigger_time()` in `api/database.py` and explicitly avoids rewriting rows, yet this entry records a cutoff-based migration as implemented. Because repository documentation is the project fact source, this will mislead future operators and reviewers about production startup behavior and should describe the runtime deduplication actually shipped.
